description: This file is a web-based troubleshooting interface for network diagnostic tools, including testing connectivity, checking IP addresses (IPv4 and IPv6), and performing traceroute operations. It contains PHP includes, HTML structure, CSS styles, and JavaScript code for handling form validation and AJAX requests.

methods.name: showTracerouteDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog showing traceroute results, with the ability to close.

methods.name: checkTraceError
methods.description: Analyzes traceroute results to determine if there was an error or if the trace was successful, then updates the UI accordingly.
